log.what: First version: research numbers for all eleven default strategies, 30% planning haircut.

Webull's real fee (0.10% + 7% VAT = 0.107%, used as 0.11% per buy and per sell) in every backtest, and lower-cost settings: IBS-dip strategies keep the T-bill half as cash (QLD IBS also dips only below IBS 0.15), metals stay in cash while flat. Each expected return = research return adjusted by the change measured in the bot's backtest; worst falls = the worse of research and bot backtest.
Added ROM Trend + RSI(2) (from the 2x ETF research): expected 50.0% a year at the real fee, worst fall −37.9%.

Added QLD Trend + bear-dip + Vol (ETF Strategy Lab v3): the QLD + Trend + bear-dip rules plus a volatility filter. Expected 34.9% a year (the bot's own backtest at the real fee, below the research's 38.4%), worst fall −34.4%.

Every strategy now plans on the same 10 years (Oct 2016 – Oct 2026) at the real fee, from one price source per family (TradingView daily for the Nasdaq / semis / ROM strategies, OANDA 4-hour for gold and silver), so the Dashboard can rank them fairly. Before, the older strategies used their 10-year research and the newer ones the longer, lower history since 2008. qld_regime 38.9→36.6; semis_regime 55.9→55.7; qld_tbd 31.6→36.6; c27_mom 32.1→32.1; c27_mom2x 56.6→56.6; qld_ibs 37.5→34.6; usd_ibs 62.9→56.5; gold_sta 7.7→14.6; gold_st30 9.0→13.2; silver_dc 12.7→12.7; silver_st 14.4→12.0; rom_tbd 50.0→49.7; qld_tbdv 34.9→45.7; usd_smh_ibs 49.6→74.5; rom_vol_ibs 42.0→59.9; gold_trend_calm 18.0→22.6; silver_gold_ok 12.2→28.5; silver_lead_1x 10.2→13.4.

Added ddm_calm_guard (DDM · Calm guard + dips): 25.8% a year, worst fall −32.8%; sso_calm_guard (SSO · Calm guard + dips): 28.8%, −37.1%; rxl_calm_guard (RXL · Calm guard + dips): 20.1%, −35.1%; over Oct 2016 – Oct 2026 on TradingView daily prices at the real fee.
